name: orrery
description: Requirements, constraints and quality KPIs as one living, observable graph — a proof of concept

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,sim -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @orrery/server dev" "pnpm --filter @orrery/web dev" "pnpm --filter @orrery/server simulate"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @orrery/web build
